## Setting Up Discrete Random Variables

```{r}
y <- c(2:12)
proby <- c(1,2,3,4,5,6,5,4,3,2,1)/36
proby
```

Using the following function to graph the PMF,

```{r}
plot.discrete <- function(y, proby) {
  bars <- as.data.frame(cbind(y, proby))
  
  ggplot(bars, aes(x=y, y=proby)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1, fill="blue", colour="black") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=rel(1.4)),
          axis.title.y=element_text(size=rel(1.4)),
          axis.text.x=element_text(size=rel(1.2)),
          axis.text.y=element_text(size=rel(1.2)),
          plot.title=)
}
```
